name: create_folder_papers
description: Create a new folder named 'papers' on the Desktop.
script:
$path = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')) "papers"
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $path -Force | Out-Null
                return "Created folder: $path"
